_what: What each profile may see and do, declared ONCE. The app (src/auth/permissions.ts) imports this file to decide what each profile is SHOWN; the proxy (rootfs/usr/bin/supervisor-proxy.py, ROLE_CAPABILITIES) reads it to decide what each profile may DO. Change a profile's rights HERE, and nowhere else. Capability names are described where the app declares them (the Capability list in permissions.ts); tests/oracles/role_table.mjs and tests/proxy-rules.py fail on a name neither side knows.
_viewCameras: Not written as a capability: a profile may view cameras exactly when 'camera' is not among its deniedTypes. The proxy derives viewCameras from that, so the two cannot disagree.
_administer: Server-side only: exempt from the Home Assistant allow-lists and the service confinement, may revoke every session and read telemetry. The app never asks for it.
_label: A profile's words, declared ONCE (architecture review, 2026-10-19; round 8, 2026-10-30): `label` its name on the sign-in card, 'Signed in as', the source of a fault and every report (src/auth/roles.ts ROLE_LABELS); `short` where space is tight (an alert card's 'To: FM'); `initials` the round signed-in badge and a fault's source icon; `description` the line under it on the sign-in card. The VESTA Agent reads the same words from the agreement (agent-contract.json `profiles`, held equal to this table by tests/oracles/agent_profiles.mjs). A step a profile writes on a fault stores its id (`role`) beside its label (`by`, the words the VESTA Agent wrote to Telegram before it read `role`), so a renamed profile renames its old steps too. `formerLabels`: the words a step was stamped with before it carried `role` (fm steps written until 2.496.622 said 'Facility manager'): read as that profile. The proxy accepts a guest's own report only as the Guest's (`role` guest, `by` its label: _fm_guest_steps_ok, GUEST_LABEL).

guest.label: Guest
guest.description: Enjoy the villa: comfort, lights, music and doors.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Everything at a glance: protection, energy, water, internet.

ops.label: Facility Manager
ops.description: On-site view: device health, batteries, what needs attention.

_agent: THE VESTA AGENT IS NOT A PROFILE. It never appears on the profile picker, never holds a cookie, and reaches only /agent/v1/* by bearer token. Its capabilities are its own; the app never reads this row.
